title: lastrea cochleata
intro: Lastrea cochleata, commonly known as the Indian fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and providing antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Lastrea cochleata are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which are a result of its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Lastrea cochleata contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions, including coughs, colds, and skin infections.
